title: What type of project am I using
content:
Summary
This question can refer both to whether a project is company-managed or team-managed and which particular Jira app the project uses.
You can find this information for each project on your View all projects page:
https://<your site name>.atlassian.net/jira/projects
Solution
Jira Service Management (JSM)
- Previously called Jira Service Desk
- JSM projects will have a URL that contains “ /servicedesk/ ”
- In a site’s View all projects page, JSM projects will show Type: Service management
Jira Software projects
- Software projects will have a URL that contains “ /software/ ”
- In a site’s View all projects page software projects will show Type: Company/Team-managed Software
- Side note: JSW projects can user either a Scrum or Kanban board
Jira Business projects
- Previously called Jira Core and Jira Work Management (JWM)
- Business projects will have a URL that includes “ /core/ ”
- In a site’s View all projects page, Business projects will show Type: Company/Team-managed Business
